why_this_is_a_gate: Every verdict here is checkable against EXTERNALLY PUBLISHED ground truth
-- Oxley, the Sage matroid database, Brandt-Wiebe, MacLane 1936, Coxeter's
coordinates -- rather than against this project's own record.  That makes
it the stronger of the two fixtures for the question 'does the type
discipline generalize', and the weaker for 'does it catch real mistakes':
MATROID_TRANSFER.md is honest that it retrodicts a published SUBTLETY
and not a published ERROR, and pins that as MISS-NO-PUBLISHED-ERROR.
All six severities here are DERIVED, with no overrides.  The graph holds
the contradicting claim in five cases and does not in the sixth, and that

TRANSPORT:IM-ML8-BASE-EXT.note: The retrodiction: exactly the shape of C08/C20, in a domain whose answer is externally known.  The certificate kind (NONSQUARE_CLASS) is INHERITED UNCHANGED from the first domain -- in JC(2) it was 'disc square class 105', here it is 'disc -3 is not a square in R'.

TRANSPORT:IM-ML8-Q-BASE-EXT.note: The minimal instance: a degree-2 extension Q -> Q(sqrt(-3)) already flips the answer.

TRANSPORT:IM-NF-SKIP-SAT.note: The saturation trap: NONEMPTY read AGAINST a NECESSARY_CONDITION edge.

TRANSPORT:IM-U35-CLOSURE.note: Graded below the others, and the distinction is real: U_3,5 IS realizable, so the conclusion happens to hold -- but the ROUTE does not, and the boundary point exhibited is not a realization.  Derived, because the graph holds no claim contradicting it.

clean_inference_notes.IM-FANO-CONTRAST: THE CONTRAST PAIR.  Identical to IM-ML8-BASE-EXT in edge type, direction and claim kind; the ONLY difference is the certificate; the verdicts are opposite.  A rule tuned to fire on 'an emptiness computed over a small field' would flag both.
clean_inference_notes.IM-ML8-ASCEND: the other half of the reversed asymmetry, on the same matroid: the same edge type that refuses EMPTY along the arrow passes NONEMPTY freely.
clean_inference_notes.IM-ML8-UP: NONEMPTY read AGAINST the arrow, licensed only because frame normalisation is a genuine EQUIVALENCE.
clean_inference_notes.IM-U35-RANK: IMAGE_CLOSURE's one conditional cell: a Zariski-CLOSED predicate extends to the closure.  This is why elimination is sound for DERIVING equations and unsound as a source of witnesses.
clean_inference_notes.IM-FANO-NO-SAT: emptiness DOES travel against the saturation edge, so a non-realizability certificate may skip saturation.  A witness may not.  Re-routed over M-E4f during the port -- see the port note below.

port_notes: IM-FANO-NO-SAT was routed in matroid_transfer.py over M-E4, the NON-Fano
saturation edge over F_2, while its claim is about the Fano ideal over Q.
That path is not connected.  The prototype has no continuity check, so it
passed silently.  Ported over a new FANO_Q_UNSAT -> FANO_Q_SAT edge M-E4f,
which is what the control was always about.  Verdict unchanged.
CM-NF-F2-EMPTY is new: the published fact 'non-Fano is representable iff
char != 2' lived in matroid_transfer.py's prose but not in its graph.
Recording it as a claim is what lets IM-NF-SKIP-SAT's true-positive
grading be derived.  Note the kernel refuses to let its certificate
base-change, which is correct: non-Fano IS realizable over Q.
